segments.name: Compliance Technology
segments.description: Provides enterprise compliance technology that automates indirect tax determination, compliance and reporting, document management and e-invoicing for global businesses.
segments.evidence: The Company operates its business as one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Enterprise and midmarket businesses license the software and solutions, paying Vertex through its direct and indirect sales organization.
revenueModel.evidence: We license our software and solutions primarily through our direct and indirect sales organization, with a focus on enterprise and midmarket businesses that have complex tax operations.
